tagline: Alpine mountain resort and leisure park operator
hero_kpi_rationale: Ski area revenue is the primary driver of Compagnie des Alpes' performance, reflecting its core business and ability to attract tourists to its resorts.
company_description: Association representing the interests of the European inland navigation sector, active in promoting knowledge exchange, accident prevention, and the development of technical standards.

kpis.name: Ski Area Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from ski area operations, including ski pass sales.
kpis.description: This KPI represents the core business of Compagnie des Alpes, directly linked to visitor traffic and ski season length.
kpis.signal: Strong post-pandemic growth, indicating the resilience of mountain tourism.

kpis.name: Leisure Park Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from leisure parks, including admissions and related services.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the performance of leisure park activities, a segment complementary to ski areas.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth, benefiting from park attractiveness and rising leisure spending.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue from all Compagnie des Alpes activities.
kpis.description: Key indicator of the company's overall financial performance.
kpis.signal: Solid overall growth, driven by both business segments.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization, measuring operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA is an important indicator of the company's ability to generate cash flow.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Net financial debt of the company.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's level of indebtedness.
kpis.signal: Moderate increase in debt, potentially related to investments.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Investment expenditures for the acquisition or improvement of long-term assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are crucial for maintaining and enhancing the attractiveness of ski areas and leisure parks.
kpis.signal: Consistent investments for site development and maintenance.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 1.15 EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.812 Bn EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 254.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Ski Area Visitor Numbers
kpis.explanation: Total skier-days recorded in ski areas.
kpis.description: This KPI directly reflects resort attractiveness and operational performance.
kpis.signal: Increased visitor traffic, confirming the return of tourists to resorts.

kpis.name: Leisure Park Visitor Numbers
kpis.explanation: Total number of visitors hosted in leisure parks.
kpis.description: Key indicator of leisure park popularity and attractiveness.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

ai_positioning.summary: Compagnie des Alpes operates in the leisure and mountain tourism sector. The information provided does not mention any involvement or strategy related to artificial intelligence.
